description: Tapestry, Inc. is a global house of iconic accessories and lifestyle brands uniting the magic of Coach and kate spade new york, and together they stretch what's possible advancing brands further than they could go alone, expanding their reach to new geographies and generations. It has two reportable segments: Coach, a global fashion house of accessories and lifestyle collections founded in New York City in 1941, which makes beautiful things crafted to last and includes global sales of primarily Coach brand products to customers through its direct-to-consumer, wholesale and licensing businesses and represented 86.4 percent of total net sales in fiscal 2026; and Kate Spade. Inspired by its consumers, it creates experiences and products that build lasting brand love and elevate everyday life.
